calibrationAttribution.interpretation: Different source hashes include controller changes; differences across source groups cannot be attributed solely to parameter overrides. payload.selectionReason: All three four-event arms are non-dominated across the 12 separate mean absolute residuals. Choose cost105 as a conservative joint candidate: its four broad speed gates pass, while cost110 improves total/remaining speed but both 2400 starts exceed the 10% gate and endpoint reserve is lower. Cost105 is not claimed to uniquely fit reality: pack and tempo residuals remain large, and no scalar weighting hides them.
